prompt_head:
Job: Solutions Architect at Smartsheet
<requirements>
- (required) 3 years relevant work experience or equivalent combination of relevant work experience and ed

paragraphs.text: I’m applying for the Solutions Architect role at Smartsheet because the posting calls for an architect who can design, build, and ship production‑grade full‑stack applications. My four years as a systems architect include building edge‑hosted platforms that combine UI, data pipelines, and AI services. That matches the need to create end‑to‑end solutions without relying on pre‑packaged tools.

At linkme I architected and deployed linkme‑intops, a React and TypeScript interface on Cloudflare Workers that gives staff a dedicated view of high‑value subscription accounts. I also built tycodes.app, an AI demo generator that turns a business URL into a shoppable 3D scroll demo in about a minute using Cloudflare Workers, Workflows, R2, and D1. To keep the output reliable I designed a six‑stage agent pipeline with a verification stage that blocks hallucinated pricing and claims. The custom data ingestion modules I added to linkme cut service delivery time by more than 30 percent. In tycodes.dev I used a Hono worker to call OpenAI for automated audit and pricing models, showing how I embed AI APIs into production code.

One gap is that my travel record shows limited trips, while the role may require up to 15 % travel. I will schedule quarterly site visits and use remote demos to prepare before each trip, ensuring I meet customer needs while keeping travel minimal.

I would welcome a conversation to discuss how my full‑stack builds and AI‑agent pipelines can support Smartsheet customers. I can also share details on the data ingestion and verification workflows I have delivered.
